page.notes: The right side of the scan shows only the binding edge, not printed text. The word "committiq;" at the line end is hard to read and is marked [?]. "pressos" is read from the ligature "preffos" and may be a slight misreading. The page ends mid-sentence on "atque im", continuing on the next page. No catchword is printed.
